decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (DV/PP/537/1 & DV/PP/537/2 received 15 March 2011) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No vehicle shall access the site using the new driveway shall not be used until the front and side boundary walls are modified so that no part of it exceeds 0.6m in height for a distance of 2.4m either side of the vehicle access and the wall shall not subsequently be increased in height.  No other fence, wall, hedge or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height shall be placed behind the wall for a distance of 2.4m deep (measured from the footway) and to a width of 2.4m either side of the vehicle access.

Condition : 5 - The approved boundary wall and landscaping proposals shown on the approved drawings as modified by Condition 4 of this consent shall be implemented and the footway reinstated in front of the new wall by removal of the drop kerb before the driveway is first brought into use and shall be so retained permanently.
description: Alterations to the existing garage (approved under planning permission 00366/20/P4 dated 17 September 2010) to convert it into a habitable room.
